### The Forerunner's Message
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/forerunners-message
Passage: Mark 1:7-8
Points:
- John the Baptist's appearance ended several centuries of prophetic silence in Israel.
- John directed people away from himself toward the far greater Messiah to come.
- Jesus' power to bestow the Holy Spirit demonstrates His divine identity and authority.
- Christ's arrival inaugurates a new exodus to bring spiritual redemption to His people.
- Outward water baptism is insufficient without the Spirit's sovereign work of inward heart renewal.
